title: Illager Stronghold Gold & Blue Key Door Skips
instructions: Using a movement speed boosted duckjump you can roll against a block object and jump around the wall with the gold key door.
notes: The blue key is normally used to unlock the gold key. Skipping the gold key door therefore removes the need for both keys; no separate blue-door jump is required.
